notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded 1516.2 predefined HLAvariableArray encoding foundation. The array prefix is a signed HLAinteger32BE element count at offset zero, and elements are padded according to their octet boundary. HLAunicodeString, HLAASCIIstring, HLAopaqueData, the standard MIM HLAargumentList, HLAmoduleDesignatorList, and the MIM's HLA<type>Handle values use that rule; the companion 1516.1 handle-encoding contract tracks the latter public-binding use. This does not establish complete BasicDataElements support, generic constructed-data encoding, public MOM reporting, package evidence, or conformance.
